desc: Establish that deleting a nonnegative value cannot improve over keeping it.
Implement and prove the rollback segment-tree approach for each distinct negative value plus no deletion.
Ensure segment-tree node state prevents deleted-only intervals from being treated as valid non-empty subarrays.
Run samples and exhaustive/random small-input validation against a naive baseline, checking one-element, all-equal, all-negative, and deletions outside the selected subarray.
Finalize the Python `Solution.maxSubarraySum` code and explanation after validation.
